description: This file defines the GatewayConnectionController class in a Swift project, responsible for managing WebSocket connections to gateways, handling discovery, TLS verification, auto-reconnect logic, and various connection configurations for an openclaw-ios app.

classes.name: GatewayConnectionController
classes.description: Main class managing gateway connections, discovery, TLS verification, and auto-reconnect logic.

classes.name: TrustPrompt
classes.description: Struct representing a trust prompt for TLS fingerprint verification.

methods.name: connectDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Initiates connection to a discovered gateway, resolving service endpoint, verifying TLS, and starting auto-connection.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Wraps connectWithDiagnostics to initiate connection to a gateway.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Starts a manual connection to specified host and port, handling TLS verification if needed.

methods.name: connectLastKnown
methods.description: Attempts to reconnect to the last known gateway based on stored settings.

methods.name: refreshActiveGatewayRegistrationFromSettings
methods.description: Rebuilds and reapplies current gateway connection configurations.

methods.name: acceptPendingTrustPrompt
methods.description: Accepts and saves the TLS fingerprint trust prompt, then proceeds to auto-connect.

methods.name: declinePendingTrustPrompt
methods.description: Declines trust and updates status to offline.
